headline: Rumors Emerge of China Planning Targeted Tariff Retaliation Against Major U.S. Tech Firms
body: Amid escalating trade tensions, China is reportedly considering imposing targeted tariffs on major U.S. technology firms, according to people familiar with the matter. The unverified reports suggest that Chinese officials are in discussions to impose duties on products from key players in the Silicon Valley area, potentially impacting consumer electronics and software exports. This strategic retaliation could be in response to the recent Section 301 tariffs announced by the United States, which targeted $60 billion worth of Chinese goods. While no official confirmation has been made, sources indicate that the announcements could be made within the next few weeks as China positions itself to defend its trade interests.
claim: China is reportedly considering imposing targeted tariffs on major U.S. technology firms.

headline: China Denies Plans to Impose Targeted Tariffs on U.S. Tech Firms
body: In response to recent rumors, a spokesperson for the Chinese government categorically rejected claims that it is considering imposing targeted tariffs on major U.S. technology firms. The spokesperson clarified that China has no plans to retaliate against products from Silicon Valley companies amid the ongoing trade discussions. The assertion that Chinese officials are in discussions to impose duties on key consumer electronics and software exports has been denied, emphasizing that any such allegations are unfounded. This statement comes in light of the recent Section 301 tariffs announced by the United States targeting $60 billion worth of Chinese goods.
denies_claim: China is reportedly considering imposing targeted tariffs on major U.S. technology firms.
